MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Medical Scientist





Job no: 943188

Work type: Part time

Located in: Various

Categories: Medical




 

Central Adelaide Local Health Network (CALHN)

The Queen Elizabeth Hospital and Royal Adelaide Hospital, Heart and Lung 

MeS1 $71,046 to $86,729 p.a. (pro rata) + super + salary packaging

Part time temporary 12 month contract available 

About CALHN
At Central Adelaide (CALHN), we're shaping the future of health through excellence in clinical care, research, and innovation. As South Australia's largest health network, we deliver exceptional, safe and connected healthcare - for our patients, our community, and our people.

With more than 17,000 dedicated employees, every day at CALHN presents an opportunity to make a real impact-not because it's expected, but because our values guide us to be our best. Find out more about CALHN sites and services, our stories and the opportunities to be part of CALHN.

About the Role

Join the Cardiology team as a Medical Scientist and play an important role in supporting quality improvement across the Cardiac Catheterisation Laboratory. You will help optimise workflows, maintain high-quality clinical data and contribute to patient safety by supporting cardiac registries, quality monitoring and research activities.

Working closely with clinicians and multidisciplinary teams, you will coordinate clinical data capture, support quality assurance initiatives, prepare reports and assist with research and clinical trials. This is a rewarding opportunity to make a meaningful impact on cardiac care through data integrity, service improvement and evidence-based practice.

About You

You are a detail-oriented professional who enjoys working with clinical data, improving healthcare services and collaborating with multidisciplinary teams.

- Experience in healthcare or clinical support services

- Analyse data and support quality improvement

- Build strong stakeholder relationships and communication

- Manage information systems with accuracy and care

- Contribute to research and service improvement

Why You'll Love It Here - CALHN benefits that matter
We know that a great career is about more than just the work you do, it's also about the support you receive. At CALHN, you'll enjoy :

Salary packaging - up to $9,010 for living expenses + $2,650 for meals & entertainment + pre-tax super & novated lease options

Safe connections - be part of a culture of safety and connectivity, focusing on outcomes and continuous improvements

Recognition & growth - celebrate success and explore opportunities across CALHN's many sites

Flexible work options - speak to us about flexibility options for this role to suit your lifestyle

Paid leave - with leave loading for rest and recharge

Health & fitness perks - discounted access to Fitness Passport & free flu vaccinations

Wellbeing support - Employee Assistance Program for you & your family

Diversity & Inclusion
We're committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels safe, respected, and supported. We strongly encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, people with disabilities, culturally diverse backgrounds, and LGBTQIA+ communities.

Application Information

Please refer to the role description for essential educational-vocational qualifications that may be required 943188 MES1 - Cardiac Quality Assessment Officer.pdf

Appointment will be subject to satisfactory Criminal History Clearances and compliant immunisation screening as indicated in the role description.

result.description:
DNA Recruitment is partnering with a leading Local Council in Melbourne's South East to recruit an experienced  Road Maintenance Officer  for a casual position with genuine long-term potential to become permanent. 
 If you're looking for stable work with the opportunity to build a career in Local Government, this is an excellent opportunity to join a supportive team making a real difference in the local community. 
 At DNA Recruitment, we're passionate about connecting great people with great employers-because supporting business is in our DNA. 
 What's on Offer 
 
 Ongoing casual role with genuine permanent opportunities 
 $36.81 per hour + Super 
 Weekly pay 
 Monday to Friday roster 
 Work-life balance with consistent daytime hours 
 Supportive team environment 
 Opportunity to establish a long-term career in Local Government 
 Meaningful work maintaining essential community infrastructure 
 
 Your Responsibilities 
 As a Road Maintenance Officer, you'll play an important role in keeping local roads and public infrastructure safe and well maintained. Your duties will include: 
 
 Maintaining and repairing roads, footpaths, kerb and channel, drainage systems and other Council assets 
 Completing minor concreting, asphalt patching and bluestone repairs 
 Operating civil plant and equipment including excavators, skid steers, rollers and compactors 
 Driving MR trucks to transport materials, machinery and equipment between worksites 
 Responding to road defects and maintenance requests 
 Installing and maintaining traffic management equipment and signage 
 Conducting pre-start inspections and basic maintenance checks on vehicles and equipment 
 Following safe work practices, completing work orders and reporting hazards 
 Working collaboratively with the Road Maintenance team to deliver high-quality outcomes 
 
 About You 
 To be successful in this role, you'll have: 
 
 Current MR (Medium Rigid) Truck Licence  (Required)  
 Provide a VicRoads 5 year demerit points histroy  (Required)  
 Current Working With Children Check  (Required)  
 Current Police Check  (Required)  
 Experience in road maintenance, civil construction or infrastructure maintenance 
 Experience operating civil plant and machinery 
 Knowledge of asphalt, concrete, drainage or road repair works 
 Construction White Card 
 Strong commitment to workplace health and safety 
 Ability to work outdoors in varying weather conditions 
 
 Highly Regarded 
 
 Traffic Management qualifications (Stop/Slow, Implement Traffic Management Plan or equivalent) 
 First Aid Certificate 
 HR Licence 
 Confined Space Ticket or other civil construction tickets 
 
 Working Hours 
  Monday to Friday  
 Hours generally operate between  7:00am and 3:00pm , with some variation depending on operational requirements. 
  Pay Rate:  $36.81 per hour + Super 
 If you're an experienced Road Maintenance professional with an MR Truck Licence and you're looking for a long-term opportunity within Local Government, we'd love to hear from you. 
  Apply now  or contact  DNA Recruitment  on  (03) 9070 1111 and ask to speak to Veronica  to discuss the role further.  Please  click here  to apply.
